_comment: Fifth seed batch reflecting two fixes verified live together: (1) evaluator.py no longer assumes message.content[0] is the judge's text block - it now scans for the first block with type=='text', so a leading ThinkingBlock from claude-sonnet-5's extended thinking (previously raised AttributeError, degrading to status='error') no longer breaks evaluation; (2) compare_models() now makes a second, more pointed retry (RETRY_CORRECTIVE_MESSAGE_2, asking the model to check each claim word-by-word) when the first retry still fails, tracked by COMPARATOR_VERSION '1.1.0' in app/evaluation/prompts.py. evaluator_version for every row in this batch is 'claude-sonnet-5:gen1.1.0:judge1.1.0:cmp1.1.0' (set live by the insert script from EVALUATOR_VERSION), distinct from batch 4's '...:cmp1.0.0'. Live verification across all 8 comparison models showed zero 'error' status rows (the ThinkingBlock bug is fixed) and 7/8 models passing cleanly; this batch reflects that. Of batch 4's single remaining Qwen Plus failure (gold symbol / Berzelius attribution), the second retry now gets Qwen Plus to disclose the unconfirmed detail as recalled outside knowledge instead of stating it as fact - faithfulness rises from 0.48 to 0.70 and status moves from 'fail' to 'warning', matching the live-verified gold-symbol result. All other batch 4 Qwen Plus scenarios were already passing after a single retry, so the second retry never fires for them and they carry over unchanged. To keep a small, realistic minority still failing outright (the retry mechanism is not a guarantee), one filler no-context scenario (gemini-3.5-flash / 'best Python web framework') is replaced with a new Qwen Plus scenario ('When was Python first released?') where a factually-true but wholly ungrounded specific detail (1991, Guido van Rossum) survives both retries - the same 'confidently-stated fabricated/ungrounded detail attached to an otherwise-correct core answer' failure mode as the original gold-symbol case, just still unresolved this time. Net effect versus batch 4: 0 'error' rows (unchanged - batch 4 never modeled that edge case either), fail count unchanged at 1/40 but now a different scenario, and 1 new 'warning' row where batch 4 had none. Same field schema as seed_scenarios_v3.json/v4.json; 'context' is not persisted (see scripts/seed_scenarios_v5.py).
